info.title: ShopFloor Twin MES API
info.description: API of the MES (Phases 4 and 5): equipment with current state, state intervals, telemetry series, shift totals, the plant clock, OEE per hour and shift, shift instances, reason codes, downtime records and the loss Pareto; alarm occurrences and alarm KPIs per hour and shift (Phase 6); operator writes (downtime coding, alarm acknowledgement, shelving and comments, handover notes) with their audits. Identity (Phase 7, ADR-0026): login sets the session cookie sft_session (POST /session); with MES_AUTH=on every route but the login needs it (401) and the permission each route names (403); MES_AUTH=off (diagnosis only) serves reads and the WebSocket without one, never a write. Writes are guarded (ADR-0023: Origin of this host, Sec-Fetch-Site, application/json, 16 KiB, a global and a per-user rate limit, MES_WRITES=off answers 405); bound to loopback by default. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Push: WebSocket at /api/v1/ws (see docs/api/realtime.md).

get.summary: Order OEE over its job windows, every job and the first-pass yield
get.description: Derived on read (ADR-0036 and its P9-04 amendment): each job of the order is head of its CNC's queue from max(accepted ?? acceptedAt, the previous job's completion, notBefore); its window runs to its completion, or to the CNC's final-through while open. Inside the windows the CNC's states give A, P and Q by the equipment rules (ADR-0021), the OP10 cycles attributed by unit (ADR-0031), summed time-weighted over the jobs. The first-pass yield across the routing (units packed good with every record good ÷ blanks taken) is beside it, never multiplied in. `final` once every input is final through the windows and no further job can come; never on a lost path (`lost`). The same body is pushed on `oee:order:<id>`. Access: permission `read` (MES_AUTH=on; ADR-0026).

get.summary: Line throughput OEE per hour or shift bucket, with the bottleneck per product
get.description: Derived on read (ADR-0036 and its P9-05 amendment): good units packed at the last operation × the designed bottleneck's effective cycle per product (deriveBottlenecks: ideal cycle ÷ machines on the operation, the largest; ASM-01) ÷ line planned busy time: the shift buckets minus the breaks and the bottleneck machines' Maintenance; in orders mode only while an order is in progress (from the earliest head time of its jobs to its completion, ADR-0031). One ratio, no A × P × Q split; not capped (`aboveOne`), null when nothing is planned. Planned time and packs count before the plant clock (`through`). `final` once every input is final through the bucket's end; `incidents` lists written-off gaps under it (`mayRevise`, `revision`). A final holds within the plant epoch it was derived under (`epoch`, #257): after a simulator restart over the same plant time, a bucket the new run re-lives may turn provisional again or change, so a final of an older epoch is replaced by a newer answer. The current hour and shift are pushed on `oee:line`. Access: permission `read` (MES_AUTH=on; ADR-0026).

post.summary: Logs in: sets the session cookie
post.description: Sets `sft_session` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/) to a new random token; a session the request carried ends. Every failure (unknown or disabled user, wrong password, a user locked for this address) is the same 401. Five failures in a row from one client address lock the user for that address for 15 minutes (the address is X-Real-IP from nginx over the edge network, else the connection's). Once a user has 10 or more failed attempts in 15 minutes from all addresses together (n), an attempt within min(2^(n-10) s, 30 s) of the last failure is answered 429 with Retry-After, the remaining wait rounded up, without checking the password, except from an address that logged in to that user within those 15 minutes; a 429 is not counted. An admin is never locked: from its fifth failure an attempt within its delay (1 s doubling, at most 5 min) is 429 with Retry-After too. Login buckets per client address and per (user name, address) answer 429 as well. Passes the write guards (login CSRF). Access: anyone (no session needed).

409.description: The version sent is not the current one (type urn:shopfloor:coding-stale, shelf-stale or note-stale): read again and retry; or the handover of the shift is closed (plant time, or a newer epoch; urn:shopfloor:handover-closed) or not open yet (urn:shopfloor:handover-not-open); or a user of that name exists (urn:shopfloor:user-exists), or the change would leave no enabled admin; or an order changed (urn:shopfloor:order-stale), is in a status the write does not apply to (urn:shopfloor:order-state), or has an earlier command not settled (urn:shopfloor:commands-unsettled); or a scrap record changed (urn:shopfloor:scrap-stale); or a close before every operation is signed off (urn:shopfloor:sign-off-missing); or a terminal write on an operation that changed (urn:shopfloor:operation-stale) or whose state does not allow it (urn:shopfloor:operation-state), by an operator not signed on at the work center (urn:shopfloor:not-signed-on), a sign-on without a terminal session (urn:shopfloor:terminal-session-required) or outside a shift (urn:shopfloor:no-shift); or an SPC characteristic changed (urn:shopfloor:limits-stale), a limit version is ended already (urn:shopfloor:limits-ended) or version 1 does not exist yet (urn:shopfloor:limits-v1-missing); or a signal changed (urn:shopfloor:signal-stale), is withdrawn (urn:shopfloor:signal-withdrawn) or acknowledged already (urn:shopfloor:signal-acknowledged); or a hold changed (urn:shopfloor:hold-stale) or is decided already (urn:shopfloor:hold-decided); or an order’s close while a unit of it is in an open hold (urn:shopfloor:quality-hold) or before genealogy has processed every fact of its units (urn:shopfloor:genealogy-pending: retry after Retry-After)

415.description: Content-Type is not application/json; type urn:shopfloor:write-not-json

422.description: Well-formed, but not applicable (a coding outside its record, overlapping or with an unknown reason; a shelf longer than maxShelveMs, without a plant clock,, an unshelve of a point not shelved; a note beyond 200 per shift, type urn:shopfloor:note-limit; a password outside 12–128 characters, equal to the current one, or a wrong current password, type urn:shopfloor:password-rejected; a dispatch to equipment that is not a CNC or has no known device run, or a re-dispatch beyond the remaining blanks; a limit window without final first-pass readings, a moving range or a complete subgroup)

429.description: Too many writes (the global limit, or the user's own; type urn:shopfloor:write-rate) or logins (per client address, per user name and address, all together, or within a user's delay: the global one after 10 failed logins in 15 minutes, or an admin's; type urn:shopfloor:login-rate): retry after Retry-After seconds
